semanticReview.topic: Normal completion versus cancellation and page cleanup
semanticReview.conclusion: Normal nonawait producer terminal marks producerEnded and retains its accepted page, runtime session and owner until the page closes. Cancel/timeout/revision invalidation seals page admission and cancels issued children. Producer cancellation catch/finally closes its own registered pages and drains worker completion before reading terminal effects. Native-child cancellation is issued before awaiting real child completion; a timer merely seals/cancels and does not join on its own timer thread. Swift actual dismissal first drains Coordinator initial/Cookie/DOM/WebJS work, then closes the JVM page and eventually session/owner. Shared closing/cleanup Tasks prevent duplicate release.

semanticReview.topic: Source edits / nonawait producer already gone
semanticReview.conclusion: Read-only runtimeIndexedSnapshot uses the existing store index and mutation revision. Source admission hashes one immutable current source off main only when that revision changes and rejects changed/deleted once-tracked sources. Observation and child admission revalidate. This same owner path closes nonawait pages after source edits even if the JVM producer task has already ended: existing Package LegadoRuntime.cancel first awaits host.cancel(taskID:) before transport Java cancellation. No new process-wide source registry or cache is needed. Accepted mutations before the seal keep their effects and are not rolled back.

Backend webJsRequest/webJsPageClose are included in both live-task sensitivity and pre-task operation error redaction. Child accepted effects merge to a still-live parent before child completion; producer cancel drains before terminal snapshot. Swift retains completedEffects before business DTO decode and on typed errors. Ordinary terminal producer receipts are not retroactively rewritten by later page operations; those facts belong to the page lifetime. Wire failures preserve safe typed codes without raw page/source/credential body logging. Page cleanup secondary failures use safe diagnostics and do not invent successful close.

MainActor handles UIKit, WK control, indexed owner snapshots and one publication hop. Source signature matching and WK message decode/encode run in nonisolated async functions with count-only SourcePerfTrace. Existing store index is reused, not another derived index. Page/task request maps are bounded transient lifetime ownership. No sleep/settle loop or main-thread blocking primitive is added. Static function/grammar checks are not Swift typechecking.
